scheduleId.description: The schedule ID of the scheduled query.

executionCount.description: The execution count for this scheduled query run.

kuery.description: The kuery to filter the results by.

page.description: The page number to return. The default is 1.

pageSize.description: The number of results to return per page. The default is 20.

sort.description: The field that is used to sort the results.

startDate.description: The start date filter (ISO 8601) to narrow down results.
